column1: # OWASP ZAP baseline rules for the jol-mcp-servers DAST probe.
#   Unlisted rules default to WARN (warnings do not fail the scan).
# The probe target is a machine-to-machine JSON-RPC endpoint
# (MCP streamable-http on loopback, no HTML, no cookies, no TLS in CI),
# so browser-oriented hardening checks are not applicable and are
# explicitly ignored. Anything unexpected beyond that should surface
# 10020 X-Frame-Options Header — no HTML content to frame
# 10021 X-Content-Type-Options Header Missing — API responses, no MIME-sniffing surface
# 10035 Strict-Transport-Security Header — plain-HTTP loopback probe, no TLS in CI
# 10050 Content Security Policy Header Not Set — no HTML content
